set.body: PRD A-16 and TY-4. Prepare the compatibility/schema-evolution policy before publication, including the binary impact of sealed-ADT changes. Once rel-publish supplies the first public release, configure and independently verify the usable previous-artifact baseline for subsequent development. An empty mimaPreviousArtifacts set is not a binary-compatibility comparison. Keep the first-release limitation explicit; do not manufacture a nonexistent earlier release. The library release group blocks on this ticket as well as rel-publish.
